draft_decided.name: draft_decided
draft_decided.value: "acquisition"."draft"."state" in ('drafting', 'awaiting_review') or ("acquisition"."draft"."decided_by" is not null and "acquisition"."draft"."decided_at" is not null)

enrolment_suspension_recorded.name: enrolment_suspension_recorded
enrolment_suspension_recorded.value:
("acquisition"."enrolment"."state"::text = 'suspended' and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_asked_at" is not null and (
             ("acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_read_back" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_method" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_costs" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_attestation" is null)
          or ("acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_attestation" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_read_back" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_method" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_costs" is null)))
       or ("acquisition"."enrolment"."state"::text <> 'suspended' and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_asked_at" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_run_id" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_read_back" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_method" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_costs" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."suspension_attestation" is null)

enrolment_way_out_recorded.name: enrolment_way_out_recorded
enrolment_way_out_recorded.value:
("acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_line" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_link" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_read_back_at" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_why" is null)
       or ("acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out" = 'written' and "acquisition"."enrolment"."state"::text in ('enrolled', 'suspended') and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_line" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_link" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_read_back_at" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_why" is null)
       or ("acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out" is not null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out" in ('cut', 'absent') and "acquisition"."enrolment"."state"::text in ('enrolled', 'suspended') and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_line" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_link" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_read_back_at" is null and "acquisition"."enrolment"."way_out_why" is not null)

protection_acknowledgement_withdrawal_ch.name: protection_acknowledgement_withdrawal_check
protection_acknowledgement_withdrawal_ch.value: ("acquisition"."protection_acknowledgement"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("acquisition"."protection_acknowledgement"."withdrawn_by" is null) and ("acquisition"."protection_acknowledgement"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("acquisition"."protection_acknowledgement"."withdrawn_run_id" is null)

acquisition.company_state_current.definition: select distinct on (company_id) company_id, stage, at, reason, actor_id from acquisition.company_state order by company_id, at desc, created_at desc
acquisition.company_state_current.name: company_state_current

acquisition.person_state_current.definition: select distinct on (person_id) person_id, stage, at, reason, actor_id from acquisition.person_state order by person_id, at desc, created_at desc
acquisition.person_state_current.name: person_state_current
